text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One day, while we're training hard for the Japan Cup, Matikanetannhauser receives a letter from the bespectacled reporter.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: In the letter, he tells her that she's inspired him many times. He also writes that Matikanetannhauser wouldn't be as inspiring if she was naturally talented at racing.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: He expresses his thanks to her for becoming his "star." Reading that, Matikanetannhauser recalls Director Akikawa's words: "It's because you're you that they're so inspired!"

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She finally understands what the director means. If someone like her can be someone's "star," then she wants to be one too, for as many people as possible.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her new dream fills her with motivation. She declares she'll be the star of the Japan Cup at a press conference, setting expectations for her at an all-time high!
